title: bedrock-bench claims
description: claims/<name>.toml, loaded as JSON: relational statements that bbench report --claims checks against a matrix report. expr and inconclusive_if are Python expressions evaluated by report/claims.py over a whitelisted AST; a claim is inconclusive when inconclusive_if holds or it does not apply to the machine.

text.description: the claim in words, as published

machine.description: machine profile label the claim is restricted to

source.description: where the claimed figure was published
